summary: AISDLC-1233 deadlock: the Step 11 push fix is a new task held at the open-PR cap (4 open of 3, DEC-0373) while all four open task PRs (#2508 #2520 #2528 #2529) cannot push until 1233 lands

options.description: Operator sets executors.openPrLimit to 5 in .ai-sdlc/dispatch/config.json (or AI_SDLC_OPEN_PR_LIMIT=5) until 1233 lands, then restores 3; planner releases the hold so 1233 claims alone

Operator applies the one-line GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS scrub in scripts/pre-push-patch-coverage.mjs from a normal checkout and opens the PR as themselves; the four PRs re-enter after it lands; AISDLC-1233 closes as landed by that PR
Keep the cap; nothing resolves on its own because every open PR fails at Step 11 until 1233 lands
